message.content:
This vertical editorial illustration features a large, stylized word "TEMPO" across the top. Below, two men in white long-sleeved shirts and dark trousers are pulling back a tan, textured surface from opposite corners to reveal three large, spherical, silver-colored tanks. The men are depicted in a cartoon style; one at the top right pulls with one hand, while the one at the bottom right pulls with two hands. The silver tanks, arranged in a diagonal line, have metallic supports and connecting pipes. The surface they are uncovering has a sandy texture on the left and transitions into a white, bubbly or wave-like pattern on the right.

Text includes "SETERU KILANG DUA MENTERI" in bold black letters on the left. Below this, smaller black text reads "Pemerintah terbelah perihal pengembangan tambang gas Masela di Maluku selatan. Konflik terbuka Menteri Sudirman Said dan Rizal Ramli." At the top, "MERAYAKAN GERHANA MATAHARI TOTAL" and "MAFIA PERKARA DI MAHKAMAH AGUNG" are visible. A barcode, "RP 39.500", "29 FEBRUARI-6 MARET 2016", and website details are at the bottom left. A red stripe runs along the far-left edge.
